$comment: Voice message audio expiry (ADR 0164, bipe-chat/bipe#622). After the upload, the sending app registers the media ID of a voice message with the API (PUT /v1/me/voice-media). The API deletes the file from the media repository transcriptDays after the upload when the message has a transcript, noTranscriptDays after it when it has none. The event and the transcript stay. Media that nobody registered never expires. Any account can keep a voice message's audio (PUT /v1/me/kept-media), up to maxKeptPerAccount; kept audio never expires while one account keeps it. The app keeps an incoming voice message with a scam warning by itself (reason scam). maxKeptPerAccount 200 is a default (about 36 MB of one-minute 24 kbit/s audio per account); MZ can overrule it. Forward marks (bipe-chat/bipe#83): a forward from a Bipe app adds the top-level object forwardKey with an integer count to the copied content: the count of the original plus 1, or 1 when the original has none. A count of forwardedManyTimes or more shows the many-times line on a voice message or audio file. A missing or malformed mark counts as 0 and means no forward line, never proof that the message was not forwarded: a modified app can drop or fake the mark. forwardedManyTimes 5 is a default (the threshold people know from other messengers); MZ can overrule it. Every forwarded message of any kind with a count of 1 or more shows a forward line (bipe-chat/bipe#933): forwarded, or forwardedManyTimes at the threshold. A forward goes to at most forwardChats chats; when a content it sends has a count of forwardedManyTimes or more (the original count plus 1), it goes to at most forwardChatsManyTimes chats, the brake other messengers put on chain messages. forwardChats 5 and forwardChatsManyTimes 1 are defaults; MZ can overrule them.
